integrity: A standalone standard-library checker reproduces exact rational barrier identities for k=2,...,16 and the two five-opinion example flows; the all-k result follows from an independent algebraic comparison proof rather than finite sampling.
scientific_limitations: Only the original deterministic incremental-voter mean-field ODE for integer k >= 2 is treated.
Stochastic-order comparability with uniform is sufficient but not necessary; initial laws with crossing tail differences are not classified.
There is no assertion about finite stochastic populations or convergence rates.
title: Stochastic-order basin selection and one-dimensional instability in the incremental voter mean field
